description: A fixed corpus for the retrieval eval. Four conversations across three days, two places and two people, with speech acts attached. Deliberately small: every expectation in cases.json must be checkable by hand, because a corpus you cannot reason about produces eval failures you cannot diagnose.
note_on_dates: `now` in cases.json is Wednesday 2026-11-25T19:00+05:30. The corpus days are chosen so that 'yesterday' (24th), 'Saturday' (21st) and 'last week' (16th-22nd) each select a different conversation. That the weekday matters is a lesson from a real defect: an extraction test compared 'by Friday' against 'the day after tomorrow' and passed for days until a Wednesday made them the same date.
